svg.title: Figure27 Distributed Authorization Context Reconstruction Model
svg.desc: NEW-shot2play Protocol Suite Version 2.0. Distributed security context collection, verification, normalization, correlation, reconstruction, policy evaluation, authorization decision, cross-service propagation, and traceability.
svg.text: Figure27 Distributed Authorization Context Reconstruction Model
Distributed Context Sources → Verification → Normalization → Correlation → Reconstruction → Policy Evaluation → Decision
All context classes retain provenance, validity, correlation, and applicable security constraints.
Conflict Detection, Authority Ranking and Reduction
Unresolved Conflict → Defined Resolution or Reject
Ranking SHALL be deterministic or policy-defined.
Reduction SHALL NOT remove required constraints.
Receiving service verifies propagated context according to the established trust relationship.
